prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the supplied ORVEN Kalistar illustration. TWO targeted equipment corrections only.
1. Repair the physically inconsistent shield / shield-hand relationship on image RIGHT. It is ONE tall rectangular worn dark-metal city-police shield, not a door or several overlapping plates. Preserve its general height, tilt and black/copper character. Rotate it slightly if needed to reveal a coherent INNER BACK face, with ONE clear solid handgrip and a strapped forearm support. His left forearm connects naturally from the existing raised shoulder to the back of the shield, gloved hand firmly grasping that grip. The shield has convincing thickness and a single continuous rim, consistent perspective. No fingers protruding magically through the plate, no cut-through panel, no detached hand. Exactly two arms and two hands in the entire image. This must be anatomically and mechanically readable.
2. Upgrade the existing very long straight spear held by his other hand. Keep a perfectly straight shaft along the original lower-left to upper-right diagonal. Add narrow luminous crimson-red Kalistel channels recessed along the full visible long black-metal shaft, with subtle red spill, interrupted naturally by leather grip and metal collars. Not a giant laser and not a curved staff. Give its spearhead a distinctive premium Dravenheim design: an elongated straight faceted silver-black central blade with a sharp thrusting tip, small paired backward-swept fang-like shoulders at its socket, elegant red luminous central fuller and copper structural details. A credible finely crafted spear, advanced ancient mechanism within the worn fantasy setting, not a generic huge halberd. The blade and shaft must be coaxial and physically joined. Keep the spear separate from the shield: it passes IN FRONT with correct occlusion, NEVER pierces or fuses into it. Keep the spearhead visible and legible.
STRICT INVARIANTS: preserve Orven's exact face, beard, expression, pose and legs, red-black uniform, capelike fabric, existing helmet shell, the two SHORT red helmet canines whose tips end at NOSE height, and the active translucent red visor ONLY between them. Do NOT lengthen the helmet canines again. Keep street, rain, framing and background unchanged and uncluttered. Keep exactly the grainy, visibly painted Kalistar style and worn material texture, no smooth 3D/plastic look. No additional characters, text, watermark or frame.
selection: User explicitly prefers the first, longer spear. Shortened draft was never pushed.
